key_patterns: Reducers are pure and monotonic (progression never regresses; see completeLesson/recordMasteryResult/isLevelComplete in src/domain/progression/index.ts). Level key is `${trackId}/${levelId}`. Lesson ids are globally unique: `<track>-<level>-<n>` (e.g. 'computer-science-beginner-1'). Mastery question ids: `<track>-<level>-m<n>`. gradeMastery returns MasteryResult { perQuestion: GradedQuestion[]{questionId,selectedIndex,correctIndex,correct}, correctCount, total, passed } (pass >= 4 of 5). deriveCompletionEvents(before,after,level,trackId) already fires only on the false->true isLevelComplete edge. The store uses a lightweight structural guard (isValidPersistedData) + a single console.warn('goalie: discarding unreadable store') fail-safe. ProgressionProvider is the single UI->persistence boundary; screens never import AsyncStorage. catalogLookup.ts exposes findTrack/findLevel/findLesson returning null on a miss. Result/MasteryResult screens mark completion on arrival and currently recompute completion events locally (to be replaced by the wrapper's badgeEarned).
